description: This file contains configuration and utility functions for authentication and API interaction in a React frontend application. It manages API base URL, tenant secret salt, and localStorage-based authentication session handling.

methods.name: normalizeBase64Url
methods.description: Normalizes a string to URL-safe base64 format by replacing '+' with '-', '/' with '_', and removing padding '=' characters.

methods.name: getStoredAuth
methods.description: Retrieves and parses the authentication object from localStorage, returning null if invalid or missing.

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Checks if the user is logged in based on the stored auth object in localStorage.

methods.name: saveAuthSession
methods.description: Saves a login session into localStorage, optionally including a token.

methods.name: clearAuthSession
methods.description: Removes the authentication session from localStorage.
